E6_messenger_and_parity.BminusL_and_Rparity_no_go: QQQL and uc uc dc ec have B-L=0, and four odd matter superfields have even Z2 matter parity; neither a subgroup of U(1)_(B-L) nor ordinary matter parity can forbid these operators
E6_messenger_and_parity.interpretation: Longer heavy-messenger mixing paths suppress a particular D5 exchange amplitude algebraically; this is a CONDITIONAL texture, not an E6-consistent full symmetry or a complete proton-decay prediction.
E6_messenger_and_parity.schur_formula: W_eff=-Ju*M^(-1)*Jd, with M=m*I+mu*adjacency(path_n), Ju on first and Jd on last messenger

KK_uniform_gap.limitation: Equal-flux classical KK branch only; mode count changes across shape walls, and unequal-flux gauge constraints still unconstructed.
KK_uniform_gap.physical_operator_requirement: If entire 11D physical fluctuation Hessian converges to equal-flux operator within norm strictly below this strip's gap, at least 2 real unstable modes persist; the norm is not calculated.
KK_uniform_gap.translation_conservation: Flux field-strength and square/flat torus geometry are torus-translation invariant; a translation-covariant physical linearized operator is block diagonal in torus momenta. Anti-linear reality pairs k and -k.

X8_local_bidegree.background_C3_local_gauge: Locally pure-internal C3_bg (background G4 has no external legs)
X8_local_bidegree.critical_caveat: This is a selection rule for the SPECIFIC Bianchi-valid example, not a theorem that the entire quadratic X8 variation vanishes after contraction with a physical background C3. X8 terms with >=5 external and <=3 internal legs could contribute; global C-field is a differential cocycle.
X8_local_bidegree.sample_quadratic_C3bg_wedge_X8: ZERO for every internal 3form in six internal dimensions because (4 internal)+(3 internal)>6

IIB_Y5.H3_homology: Z + Z_g by Poincare duality to H^2(Y,Z)
IIB_Y5.integral_half_shift: lambda=p1(TY)/2=0, because TY stable pullback of T(S2xS2) and p1(base)=0
IIB_Y5.winding_character_difference: Abstract flat differential degree-4 characters (3-gerbes) on Y are NOT identical to flat U(1) line-bundle characters Hom(pi1,U1), even though both have Z_g components; IIB physical RR potentials are C0, C2 and C4, not an independent C3 field.

differential_Cfield_topology.large_scope_warning: Differential character flat moduli of isolated spaces are topological, not the physical quantized Page-charge group. Actual M/IIB duality relates higher-dimensional backgrounds with nontrivial flux and couplings; this is NOT a charge-duality derivation.

optical_active_switch.limitations: Ideal coherent switches and independent, unbiased detector loss; realistic insertion losses, mode matching, pulse shape, PMD, feedforward delay and randomized-basis implementation must be calibrated.
optical_active_switch.minimum_switch_timing_slots: Distinct routing operation must switch on 1 ns-separated time bins; insertion losses and spectral overlap are additional
